creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`rad docs RAD20046` renders its answer table with the escapes showing:

```
| confirm, confirm $\...\`` | yes / no (also y, n, true, false) |
```

The source (`core/error_docs/20046.md:23`) writes the confirm-shell syntax with backslash-escaped backticks:

```
| `confirm`, `confirm $\`...\`` | ...
```

That form isn't valid markdown in either of our renderers. The terminal renderer (`core/markdown_render.go`) matches inline code with a single-backtick regex, so the backslashes and a spare backtick print literally. The web pipeline (Python-Markdown with our mkdocs extensions) is worse: it emits `confirm $\` as the code span and the stray backtick swallows the next `|`, merging the table's cells.

Same pattern in `core/error_docs/20010.md`, `docs-web/docs/guide/global-flags.md` (embedded, so `rad docs guide/global-flags` shows it too), and `docs-web/docs/examples/brewi.md` / `hm.md`.

CommonMark double-backtick spans render correctly through the web pipeline (verified against Python-Markdown with our extension set):

```
| ``confirm $`...` `` | ...
```

So probably: convert the sources to that form and teach `markdown_render.go` multi-backtick code spans, which its inline-code regex doesn't know today.
title: Fix escaped-backtick garbling in rad docs and website tables
